membership-fees.module.name: Membership fees
membership-fees.module.description: Prices for membership schemes, and taking the fee online through Payments, with the income posted to the ledger. Leave it off where members pay somebody else, such as a students' union.
membership-fees.settings.checkout.pay-wi: How long a payment may take before it is given up. The application itself stays open, and the person can press Pay again.
membership-fees.settings.refunds.end-on-: End a membership when its fee is refunded in full
A part refund always leaves the membership running.
membership-fees.settings.retention.charg: When the record of what a membership was charged is removed. Keep it at least as long as the ledger is kept.
membership-fees.abilities.price.manage.l: Set the fees for membership schemes
membership-fees.abilities.charge.view.la: See a membership's fee and payment
membership-fees.abilities.charge.waive.l: Waive a membership fee, with a reason
membership-fees.abilities.refund.request: Ask for a refund of a membership fee
